verdict.rationale: Unstructured's docs say partitioning turns files into structured document elements and metadata in a 'contextualized' JSON format, and a by-title chunking strategy implies headings are detected and used to keep sections together. The pack never explicitly documents heading or element types, section hierarchy, or reading-order preservation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/title element types and parent-child hierarchy metadata, reading-order guarantees for multi-column layouts, independent or hands-on corroboration of structure fidelity.
